mapper.select: SELECT TOTAL_SALARY, WITHHELD_TAX, NATIONAL_PENSION, HEALTH_INSURANCE, DEPENDENTS, CHILDREN, MONTHLY_RENT, HOUSING_SAVING, PENSION_SAVING, IRP_SAVING, SME_REDUCTION_YN, UPDATED_AT FROM INCOME WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND TAX_YEAR = #{taxYear}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO INCOME i USING DUAL ON (i.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND i.TAX_YEAR = #{taxYear}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET i.TOTAL_SALARY = #{req.totalSalary}, i.WITHHELD_TAX = #{req.withheldTax}, i.NATIONAL_PENSION = NVL(#{req.nationalPension}, 0), i.HEALTH_INSURANCE = NVL(#{req.healthInsurance}, 0), i.DEPENDENTS = NVL(#{req.dependents}, 0), i.CHILDREN = NVL(#{req.children}, 0), i.MONTHLY_RENT = NVL(#{req.monthlyRent}, 0), i.HOUSING_SAVING = NVL(#{req.housingSaving}, 0), i.PENSION_SAVING = NVL(#{req.pensionSaving}, 0), i.IRP_SAVING = NVL(#{req.irpSaving}, 0), i.SME_REDUCTION_YN = NVL(#{req.smeReductionYn}, 'N'), i.UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (INCOME_ID, MEMBER_ID, TAX_YEAR, TOTAL_SALARY, WITHHELD_TAX, NATIONAL_PENSION, HEALTH_INSURANCE, DEPENDENTS, CHILDREN, MONTHLY_RENT, HOUSING_SAVING, PENSION_SAVING, IRP_SAVING, SME_REDUCTION_YN) VALUES (SEQ_INCOME.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{taxYear}, #{req.totalSalary}, #{req.withheldTax}, NVL(#{req.nationalPension}, 0), NVL(#{req.healthInsurance}, 0), NVL(#{req.dependents}, 0), NVL(#{req.children}, 0), NVL(#{req.monthlyRent}, 0), NVL(#{req.housingSaving}, 0), NVL(#{req.pensionSaving}, 0), NVL(#{req.irpSaving}, 0), NVL(#{req.smeReductionYn}, 'N'))
